name: A2 · Básico
description: Passado simples, planos e futuro, comparar coisas, comida e compras, direções, pedidos educados com can/could.

flashcards.back: Verbo + -ed: work → worked, play → played. Termina em -e: +d (live → lived). Consoante + y → -ied (study → studied).
flashcards.en: I worked yesterday and I played soccer.
flashcards.syl: ai UÉRKT IÉS-ter-dêi end ai pléid SÓ-ker

flashcards.back: go → went · see → saw · eat → ate · have → had · buy → bought · come → came · do → did · get → got · make → made · take → took.
flashcards.en: I went, I saw, I ate, I had, I bought.
flashcards.syl: ai uênt, ai só, ai ét, ai réd, ai BÓT

flashcards.back: didn't + verbo base / Did + sujeito + verbo base? O verbo principal volta ao infinitivo.
flashcards.en: Did you go to the party? No, I didn't go.
flashcards.syl: did iú gôu tu dâ PÁR-ti · nôu, ai DÍ-dent gôu

flashcards.back: yesterday · last night/week/year · two days ago · in 2020 · when I was a kid.
flashcards.en: I saw him two days ago.
flashcards.syl: ai só rim tu dêiz â-GÔU

flashcards.back: going to = plano/intenção já decidida ou evidência no presente. will = decisão na hora, previsão, promessa, oferta.
flashcards.en: I'm going to study tonight. I'll help you!
flashcards.syl: aim GÔU-ing tu STÂ-di tu-NÁIT · áiu rélp iú

flashcards.front: Como fazer a pergunta com going to?
flashcards.back: Are you going to...? / Is she going to...?. Negativa: I'm not going to... / He isn't going to...
flashcards.en: Are you going to travel this year?
flashcards.syl: ar iú GÔU-ing tu TRÉ-vou dis IÉR

flashcards.back: Adjetivo + -er + than: tall → taller than, big → bigger (dobra a consoante), happy → happier.
flashcards.en: My brother is taller than me.
flashcards.syl: mai BRÂ-der iz TÓ-ler dén mi

flashcards.back: more + adjetivo + than: more expensive than, more interesting than.
flashcards.en: This phone is more expensive than that one.
flashcards.syl: dis fôun iz mór ex-PÉN-siv dén dét uân

flashcards.back: the + adj+est / the most + adj: the tallest, the most beautiful. Irregulares: good → better → the best; bad → worse → the worst.
flashcards.en: She is the best student in the class.
flashcards.syl: chi iz dâ BÉST STIÚ-dent in dâ klés

flashcards.back: Contáveis têm plural (apple/apples): many, a few. Incontáveis não (milk, water, rice, money): much, a little.
flashcards.en: How much water do you drink? How many apples?
flashcards.syl: rau mâtch UÓ-ter du iú DRINK · rau MÉ-ni É-pouz

flashcards.back: I'd like... / Can I have...? / (EUA) Can I get...?. Evite 'I want' (seco).
flashcards.en: I'd like a burger and a coke, please.
flashcards.syl: aid laik â BÉR-guer end â kôuk, plíz

flashcards.back: EUA: Can I get the check, please? · Reino Unido: the bill.
flashcards.en: Can I get the check, please?
flashcards.syl: kén ai guét dâ tchék plíz

flashcards.back: Excuse me, how do I get to the station? / Where is the nearest bank?
flashcards.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?
flashcards.syl: ex-KIÚZ mi, rau du ai guét tu dâ STÊI-chen

flashcards.back: turn left/right · go straight (ahead) · at the corner · next to · across from · between · on the left.
flashcards.en: Go straight and turn left at the corner.
flashcards.syl: gôu stréit end térn léft ét dâ KÓR-ner

flashcards.back: Can I...? informal. Could I...? mais educado. Para pedir algo a alguém: Could you...?
I can swim. / I can't drive. / Can you cook? Passado: could (When I was young, I could run fast).
flashcards.en: I can swim, but I can't drive.
flashcards.syl: ai kén suím, bât ai ként dráiv

flashcards.back: Would you like...? é a oferta educada (Would you like some tea?). Do you want é mais direto/informal.

questions.question: Last weekend I ___ a movie.
questions.en: Last weekend I saw a movie.

questions.question: ___ you watch the game last night?
questions.explanation: Pergunta no passado: Did + sujeito + verbo base.
questions.en: Did you watch the game last night?

questions.question: I ___ my keys two days ago.
Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
— The phone is ringing. — I ___ get it!
We ___ going to visit my parents next month.
questions.explanation: be going to: we are going to.

questions.question: This bag is ___ than that one.
She is the ___ student in the class.
This film is ___ than the book.
Which is the most natural way to order in a US café?
options: Can I get a coffee, please?
questions.explanation: Can I get...? é o jeito natural nos EUA.
questions.en: Can I get a coffee, please?

questions.question: There are ___ apples in the bag.
Go ___ and turn right at the corner.
The bank is ___ the supermarket and the pharmacy.
How do I ___ to the airport?
questions.explanation: 'How do I get to...?' é a pergunta padrão de direções.
questions.en: How do I get to the airport?

questions.question: Which request is the most polite?
options: Could you open the window, please?
questions.explanation: Could you... please? é o mais educado dos quatro.

questions.question: I ___ speak Spanish, but I can speak English.
Would you like some water? Escolha a resposta educada.
questions.explanation: Aceitar uma oferta: Yes, please. Recusar: No, thanks.
